inputs.original_text: The Punjab and Haryana High Court granted regular bail to an accused booked under national security provisions and the Official Secrets Act, holding that mere suspicion of sharing sensitive information with someone in Pakistan cannot justify prolonged incarceration. He was allegedly in telephone contact with Karachi-based “Punjabi Kuri”. The message ends as it begins to describe the court’s direction for his release.
